summary: Frontend-only validation completed on the public preview URL for homepage cinematic ASCII/background scope. Eye/Blob/Founder motif placement, readability, reduced-motion freezing, responsive overflow, pricing/partners exclusion, and core CTA/navigation checks passed. One critical regression was reproduced: binary-hands canvas continues changing while offscreen, violating offscreen pause requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Canvas pixels continue changing while canvas is out of viewport (offscreen at founder section), indicating animation loop is still active instead of paused.

integration_issues.issue: Binary hands canvas does not reliably stop visual updates offscreen; sampled hashes changed repeatedly while inViewport=false.

action_items: Fix BinaryHandsCanvas offscreen lifecycle so RAF/draw updates fully halt when IntersectionObserver reports non-intersecting.
Re-test binary canvas for deterministic stop/resume behavior after repeated scroll cycles.
Optional hardening: ensure reduced-mode state metadata remains consistent across canvases after runtime motion toggle events.
critical_code_review_comments: AsciiEyeField, AsciiBlobField, and FounderOceanScene matched requested placement, nonblank rendering, and reduced-motion freeze behavior in this run.
Old duplicate eye backdrop in the Fluid/Strict section is absent (pillar-backdrop/pillar-eye nodes not present), and a single ascii blob field is rendered behind all four cards.
BinaryHandsCanvas likely has an observer/run-loop lifecycle edge case: offscreen hash changes persisted despite inViewport=false, which conflicts with the implemented stop-on-offscreen intent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated against public preview URL. Passed: eye scene integration/readability, blob scene placement/readability, founder comet scene readability + CTA visibility, motif uniqueness (one each on homepage), no homepage runtime duplicate data-testid values, pricing/partners contain none of these canvas motifs, no horizontal overflow at 320x700 / 390x844 / 768x900 / 1440x900 / 1920x800, and See AHI Live deep-link hash flow works (#ahi-live). Failed: binary-hands-canvas kept changing pixel hashes while offscreen at founder section.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: load homepage, confirm binary canvas animates at hero, scroll to founder section until binary canvas is out of viewport, sample binary canvas pixel hashes repeatedly (~450ms intervals). Result: hash values keep changing while inViewport=false. This indicates offscreen draw updates are still happening (or restart/cancel race), violating expected offscreen pause contract. Mitigation: enforce strict RAF cancellation/state gate on non-intersection and avoid scheduling next frame when visibility flag is false.
